dataset.source: Exness public XAUUSD ticks, M1 MID

role: Previously revealed November development diagnostic. Matching original entries does not create a fresh examination.

assumptions.bidAsk: M1 MID to BID/ASK via fixed modeled spread. Round-trip commission and slippage are charged per ounce.
assumptions.cohort: 142 original November setups. Later variants retain the original opportunity count. Missing data and absent valid geometry remain explicitly censored or invalid.
assumptions.entry: Delays use next opens and skip prior invalidations and completed TP2 moves. Limits require passage beyond the price or marketability at open. Intrabar limits have no same-bar target credit, and stops can fire on the fill bar.
assumptions.exits: SL gets priority within an ambiguous bar. Gap stops use the open where worse, except the two original-policy replicas. Stop updates and dynamic exits only use completed bars.
assumptions.drawdown: Equal initial risk per filled opportunity, ordered by entry. Longer variants can overlap. This does not model levered account equity, sizing, layering, liquidation, or portfolio drawdown.
assumptions.session: Next 17:00 New York daily market boundary. DST uses the New York time zone. A dataset ending mid-session censors unfinished positions.
assumptions.costSensitivity: Spread changes executable prices, with original plan geometry and opportunity timestamps held fixed.

tickReplay.source: Exness November recorded tick bid/ask, stable-sorted by timestamp. First quote at or after publication. Fixed model slippage and commission.
